SD47-002.name: Medjeowl
SD47-002.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Ten Crown"/"Winged Beast" families.

[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Mystery Seal] (When Summoned)
You can exchange one of your Life cores for [Soul Core] on your Reserve.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on your "Winged Beast" family Spirits/Ultimates can't be brought to 0 by opposing effects.

SD47-004.name: Tamarix Hoopoe
SD47-004.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Green Core])]
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Green "Ten Crown"/"Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card, and a Green "Imagine"/"Worldswalker" family Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

PX16-03.name: The AncientGodKing GodBird Gardarla
PX16-03.effect:
[Burst: s] (After you or the opponent [Seal, Seal)]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1-2-3] (When Summoned)
You can put three cores from the Void to any of your "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirits.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, at the end of battle, by sending an opposing Life to the Reserve, refresh this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12453.name: The SkyLionheart Northree
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12453.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
[During Seal] Also, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12454.name: The SkyLionheart Peaphoenix
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12454.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
[heb]
After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned via an effect, return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12456.name: The SkyLionheart Saqr-Hawk
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12456.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Winged Beast Spirit/Ultimate]

When summoning this revealed card, ignore its Summon Condition.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
You can banish all Red/Purple cards on the opposing Trash. When you've done so, for each card banised via this effect, send a core from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

[LV4][LV5]
All your "Sky"-named Spirits/Ultimates are unaffected by opposing Nexus/Purple Spirit effects.

SD47-X02.name: The SkyWarship Pyramid Wing
SD47-X02.effect:
When this set card is discarded by the opponent, you can activate it, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Summon any number of "Winged Beast" family Spirit cards/Ultimate cards among them, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the decktop.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12526.name: The SkyBravePrincess Nefals
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12526.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

When this card is revealed from the deck, you can use its [Accel].

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core][Core])]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone. Or, instead of putting it onto the Removed Zone, summon it by paying one cost.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to this Ultimate.

SD47-X01.name: The SkyGodKing Budgie-Pesed
SD47-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned)
You can send [Soul Core] from your Reserve to your Life.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, put a core from the Void to any Green-only Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 5 or more "Winged Beast" family Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.

SD47-X03.name: The SkyGodKing Gale-Phoenix-Horus
SD47-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [Grand Soar] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by either paying one cost, or putting a core from any Green Grandwalker Nexus you control to this Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV2][LV3] 2 (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
[heb]

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14358.name: Wadjet Pigeon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14358.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "Winged Beast" family Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can discard one card from your Hand for each of those Spirits/Ultimates. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to each of those Spirits/Ultimates, and they remain on the Field, exhausted.

SD47-CP01.name: Yoku Albatrosa (Card)
SD47-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Winged Beast/Ten Crown/God-King/Worldswalker/Avatar & Cost 3 or more) (Imagine Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

When this card is revealed from deck by your Green Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this nexus to the Void) Pay one cost to summon a "Winged Beast" family Spirit card/Ultimate card from your Hand. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[During Seal] [Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Winged Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate attacks, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.
